resources.string: Roamio stores your display name, temperature unit, home currency, and places you star on this device. With your permission, we use your location to show nearby destinations and weather.
Saved settings personalize Home, Convert, and place detail. Location is used only to load explore content for your area. We do not sell your data.

Roamio loads public travel data from services such as OpenStreetMap, Wikipedia, Open-Meteo, and Frankfurter. Those requests may include coordinates or place names needed to show content. Their own policies apply when data leaves the app.

You can change your name, units, and currency in Settings. Deny location permission and Roamio will use a default city until you search for another place. Delete starred places from Saved at any time.
